spec.scene: A warm kitchen patch paved with terracotta tiles. In the center, a sturdy dark wood prep table is covered in soaked pale corn husks, mounds of dough, and wrapped tamales. An older woman in a floral apron guides a younger figure in a cream shirt. To the right, a basket of vibrant orange mangos and a clay pitcher of bright yellow flowers rest on the counter. At the back edge, a small wooden radio sits near a tiled kitchen wall catching the warm golden sunlight.
spec.title: Tamales con la Abuela
spec.caption: Mi abuela me enseñó a doblar las hojas de maíz.
